nodes.label: Phase 0a Follow-Ups Round 2
nodes.rationale: Closes the four items the first pass created or made cheap. cargo fmt --all --check is listed first in the verification bar deliberately: the previous pass shipped a formatting violation that survived its own review and five later verification passes because no bar named it.

nodes.label: FORBIDDEN_PAIRS
nodes.rationale: A named-pair exception a tier rule cannot express: lapidary-api may not depend on lapidary-cad because the open path lives there. A forbidden-pairs list beats an allow-list of api's permitted L2 deps — an allow-list must be edited every time api legitimately gains a dependency, and a list edited to permit ordinary work gets widened carelessly. Each entry carries its reason as the message, kept next to the rule rather than in a distant match arm.

nodes.label: SERVER_FEATURES
nodes.rationale: A build argument defaulting to empty so the api image links no kernel and the worker image does. Chosen over splitting the binary by role, which needs a role concept that does not exist until the worker leases jobs. The expansion must add no --features flag at all when empty — an empty --features "" is not the same thing.

nodes.label: Empty-State Copy Truthfulness
nodes.rationale: 'Drop a folder of STL or STEP files to begin' promised an interaction nothing implemented. Fixed now rather than deferred to Phase 1: the string ships in the UI today and tells users to do something that does nothing. The replacement must not promise an unimplemented affordance, must not read as an error (an empty library is a normal state), and stays in strings.ts.
